```bash
#!/bin/bash

# Check if the API_KEY environment variable is set
if [ -z "$API_KEY" ]; then
  echo "Error: API_KEY environment variable is not set."
  exit 1
fi

# Example URL
URL="https://api.example.com/data"

# Call curl using the API key in the Authorization header
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" "$URL"
```
